stem:
Priya notices that a new money plant has grown from a stem cutting her grandmother placed in a bottle of water at home.

Which statement explains why this is an example of vegetative propagation rather than reproduction by seeds?

options.text: The new plant grew faster than a plant grown from a seed.
The new plant grew from a part of a single parent plant, not from a seed formed by two parents.
The new plant grew in water instead of in soil.
The new plant has shiny green leaves like the parent plant.

teacher.key_rationale: A money plant growing from a stem cutting is vegetative propagation: a new individual arises from a body part of one parent, with no seed and no mixing of instructions from two parents. Option B states exactly this. Option A (speed of growth) is irrelevant to the type of reproduction; option C (water vs soil) is a growing condition, not a reproductive feature; option D (leaf appearance) is a superficial trait. Key is B.
